item.title: Women’s AFCON 2026 faces venue uncertainty weeks before start
item.description: By Kwame Bediako Reports are swirling that Morocco has withdrawn from hosting the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON), originally set for March 19 to April 3.
